scope: standalone synthetic complete point-RMW validator; no DBMS throughput claim

correctness.exhaustive: all subsets of 3-key universe, ordered batches n=0..4, k=1/2/3
correctness.oracle: independent all-pair intersection and every-round degree recomputation
correctness.counterexamples: frozen top-k, strict size<k, tie-break, directed R!=W rejection

aggregation: paired per-trace per-repetition differences and ratios; median within seed then across five seeds; preserve all observations and min/max
measurement: fresh sequential process per variant; timed API includes normalization, index/graph build, selection/trim, decision construction, scratch destruction; input parse, verification and JSON serialization excluded; RSS process high-water
warmup: none; fresh-process performance including cold allocator behavior; no cross-process warm-cache claim
workload_claim: synthetic, n=40 represents paper default batch size only; not original SmallBank or original 5-read/5-write microbenchmark
failure_policy: save timeout, memory_limit, unsupported, error and unexecuted; never silently omit failed variants
